(Per: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ASHUTOSH KUMAR)
5 21-06-2023 Re: Interlocutory Application No. 3 of 2023
By way of the present interlocutory application, the appellant/applicant seeks suspension of sentence on several grounds but primary being that he is in custody for about ten years by now.

The appellant/applicant has been convicted under Sections 376, 302 and 201 of the Indian Penal Code vide judgment of conviction dated 10.04.2014 and order of sentence dated 16.04.2014 passed by the learned Special Judge, Siwan in G.R. No. 2185/13/ S. Patna High Court CR. APP (DB) No.475 of 2014(5) dt.21-06-2023 Tr. No. 372/13 (Arising out of Hussainganj P.S. Case No. 109/13) and has been sentenced to undergo R.I. for life under Section 302 of the Indian Penal Code and R.I. for 10 years under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code, to pay a fine of Rs. 5,000/- and R.I. for 5 years under Section 201 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Chandrama Yadav vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 Mr. Vishwajeet Kumar, the learned Advocate for the appellant/applicant has submitted that though the accusation appears to be very grave but there is no eye witness to the occurrence nor there is any supportive medical evidence.

However, looking at the nature of the offence and the accusation against the appellant/applicant, we have not been persuaded to take any different view in the matter so far as suspension of sentence is concerned, notwithstanding the fact that the appellant/applicant has Patna High Court CR.
APP (DB) No.475 of 2014(5) dt.21-06-2023 remained in custody for about ten years by now.
The prayer for suspension of sentence is thus rejected.
However, considering the period of custody of the appellant/applicant, we direct that the paper book be prepared and case be listed for final hearing.
Interlocutory Application No. 03 of 2023 stands disposed off accordingly.

(Ashutosh Kumar, J) ( Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) Mayank/Sunil kr.
